⚙️ Executor Compatibility:
The script works on all executors, however executors with weak execution such as Xeno and Solara will run the script in a limited mode, meaning some features may not work properly.

Free executors like Velocity and bunni lol offer better performance compared to them.

For mobile, the script performs best on the Delta executor.
On PC, the best and most stable experience is guaranteed on all paid executors, where all features work properly.
